_scope: Phase 8A — deterministic evaluation of rag/retriever.py's vector retrieval quality, independent of recommendation/answer/LLM quality. Targets retrieve() directly — the canonical Chroma vector-search backend (Phase 4B's preferred implementation, used by tools/deadlines_tool.py, eligibility_tool.py, application_steps_tool.py, and via retrieval/retriever_service.py by tools/rag_tool.py).
_source: Hand-curated against the real, live persisted Chroma store — every expected_sources/forbidden_sources/expect_empty value below was verified against actual retrieve() output before being written here, not assumed.

cases.description: Eligibility query, filtered to eligibility — top result must be the eligibility page.
cases.query: what gpa do i need for a doctoral program
cases.notes: Verified live: top-3 scores 0.74/0.62/0.61, all page_type=eligibility.

cases.description: Deadlines query, filtered to deadlines — top result must be the deadlines page.
cases.query: when is the fall application deadline
cases.notes: Verified live: this case also reproducibly surfaces a duplicate chunk_id (c31caccf_0000 three times) — RETRIEVE-012 is the dedicated case for that finding; allow_duplicate_chunks=true here so this case's own purpose (source correctness, which passes) isn't masked by an unrelated, already-tracked issue.

cases.query: how do i apply to a doctoral program
i dont know where to start with graduate school

cases.description: FAQ query (advisor appointment), filtered to faq.
cases.query: how do i request an appointment with an advisor
cases.notes: Verified live: top-3 scores 0.43/0.42/0.41 — weaker but all above MIN_RELEVANCE=0.30.

cases.query: what documents do i need to submit my application
cases.notes: Verified live: top-3 scores 0.37/0.36/0.32 — close to threshold, a useful low-margin regression case.

cases.description: Cross-source query, no page_type filter — must return something, no forbidden assertion (discovered program-application content is a valid, expected hit here).
cases.query: what are the steps to apply for graduate school
cases.notes: Verified live: top result page_type=program_application (discovered content), score 0.69 — intentionally no expected_sources constraint since multiple page_types are legitimately relevant.

cases.description: Out-of-scope gibberish query — must correctly return nothing.
cases.query: xyzxyzxyz totally unrelated gibberish nonsense query
cases.notes: Verified live: zero results — correct behavior, not a defect. This case exists to confirm the MIN_RELEVANCE threshold correctly rejects nonsense.

cases.description: Deliberately mismatched filter — an eligibility-shaped query filtered to page_type=deadlines must never return eligibility-page content (proves the filter actually restricts the search, not just biases it).
cases.query: what gpa do i need for a doctoral program
cases.notes: Verified live: returns exactly 1 weakly-relevant deadlines-page chunk (score 0.36) — page_type filter correctly excludes eligibility content even though the query is semantically about eligibility. expect_empty=false because a real (if weak) deadlines match exists; the assertion that matters is the forbidden_sources check.

cases.description: Empty query string — must return nothing without error.
cases.notes: retrieve()'s own documented contract: empty/whitespace query returns [] immediately.

cases.description: Whitespace-only query — same contract as empty string.

Duplicate-chunk awareness case — the deadlines query that reproducibly returns the same chunk_id three times. This phase only MEASURES this; fixing it is explicitly out of scope (Non-goals: do not redesign retrieval/chunking/ranking).
cases.query: when is the fall application deadline
cases.notes: Verified live and reproducible across repeated calls: chunk_id c31caccf_0000 appears 3 times in a k=3 result set. allow_duplicate_chunks=true means this specific case's status is unaffected by the duplicate finding — the duplicate is still recorded in metrics/error_summary for visibility, just not scored as a failure for this known, pre-existing, out-of-scope-to-fix case.
